# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b97 — hide external power selector on battery-reporting physical devices

Beta97 follows published Beta96. It changes **only the Home Assistant selector entities exposed by HEM**, not native device control, PID, window rules, notification routing, or physical relay state.

## Per-device external power-switch selector

- No longer register `select.*_power_switch_entity` on a managed physical device that **reports battery information**, either directly as one of its actual native device attributes or through a battery sensor/entity registered under the **same physical HA device ID**.
- A room's unrelated battery sensor cannot hide another physical device's selector. Mains-powered fans, climate devices, humidifiers, switches and number/valve actuators still retain their optional external power-switch dropdown.
- Classify from actual native sensor/device-class metadata and battery reports, not the product name, manufacturer or presence of an arbitrary room battery sensor. A registered battery entity still counts if it happens to be temporarily unavailable.
- Remove any **previously registered HEM power-switch selector entity** for such a battery-reporting device using its exact `select` domain, HEM platform and controller-specific unique ID. This also retires a user-renamed selector without altering other HEM controls or unrelated entities.
- Keep any existing saved `power_switch_entity` association and all native power safety state intact: hiding the selector is a UI change and does not silently send ON/OFF commands, change configured power ownership, or reset compressor dwell history. A user who wants to change a legacy association can do so through a controlled HEM configuration update; this release never auto-disconnects or powers it.

## Validation

The production detector and actual `select.async_setup_entry` registration are exercised against isolated HA state and entity-registry fixtures for native battery attributes, an accompanying registered battery diagnostic sensor, temporary unavailable battery telemetry, independent mains devices in the same room, controller-specific legacy selector removal and configuration preservation. The release also reruns existing Beta66–96 controller, window, source, DRY-only, upstream power, restart and real Chromium dashboard suites.

## Install

Update Home Environment Manager to **v0.6.0b97** through HACS prereleases and restart Home Assistant. The battery-backed devices' power-switch selector will be absent from their HA device page; other device controls remain visible.
